title: MongoDB Aggregation Framework and Mongoose
objectives: Master aggregation pipelines, `$lookup`, `$group`, and Mongoose ODM.
theory_markdown:
The aggregation pipeline processes documents through stages. Key stages: `$match` (filter), `$project` (reshape), `$group` (aggregate), `$sort`, `$limit`, `$skip`, `$lookup` (join), `$unwind` (deconstruct arrays), `$addFields` (compute), `$facet` (multiple pipelines).

Mongoose is an ODM (Object Document Mapper) that provides schema validation, middleware, and population (referencing other collections).

code_walkthrough.explanation: `$unwind` flattens array items. `$lookup` performs a left join. `$facet` runs multiple aggregation pipelines in parallel. Mongoose schemas enforce validation at the application level. Virtuals compute derived properties. Middleware runs before/after operations.

ai_tool_spotlight.description: Use **MongoDB Compass** aggregation builder for visual pipeline construction. Use **Mongoose** documentation for schema design patterns.
